Name: Axebot
Notes: [info] Respawns with <Boot Up> via {stock}.

Name: Calcified Cultist
Pattern: Opens with <Incantation>, then always uses <Dark Strike>.

Name: Chomper
Notes: [info] 1st starts <Clamp>, 2nd starts <Screech>.

Name: Corpse Slug
Notes: [info] 1st starts randomly, each subsequent starts at the next point in the cycle.

Name: Cubex Construct
Pattern:
Opens with <Charge Up>.
Then cycles <Repeater Blast> → <Repeater Blast> → <Expel Blast>.
Notes: [bug] As of v0.99.1 <Submerge> is never used in the cycle.

Name: Damp Cultist
Pattern: Opens with <Incantation>, then always uses <Dark Strike>.

Name: Devoted Sculptor
Pattern: Opens with <Forbidden Incantation>, then always uses <Savage>.

Name: Exoskeleton
Notes: [info] 1st starts <Skitter>, 2nd starts <Mandible>, 3rd starts <Enrage>, 4th starts randomly.

Name: Fabricator
Pattern:
When allies ≤ 2: Chooses randomly from <Fabricate>, <Fabricating Strike>.
When allies ≥ 3: Always uses <Disintegrate>.

Name: Flyconid
Pattern:
Opens with <Frail Spores> or <Smash>.
Then chooses randomly from <Vulnerable Spores>, <Frail Spores>, <Smash>.

Name: Fogmog
Pattern:
Opens with <Illusion> → <Swipe>.
After <Swipe> (1st in a row): 40% <Swipe>, 60% <Headbutt>.
After <Swipe> (2nd in a row): Always uses <Headbutt>.
After <Headbutt>: Always uses <Swipe>.

Name: Fossil Stalker
Pattern:
Opens with <Latch>.
Then chooses randomly from <Tackle>, <Latch>, <Lash>.
Notes: [coop]🤝 Gains a set amount of Strength on hit instead of per-player.

Name: Frog Knight
Pattern:
Phase 1:
Cycles <Tongue Lash> → <Strike Down Evil> → <For the Queen>.

Phase 2 (below 50% HP after using <For the Queen>):
Uses <Beetle Charge> once, then restarts Phase 1.

Name: Fuzzy Wurm Crawler
Pattern:
Opens with <Acid Goop>.
Then cycles <Inhale> → <Acid Goop> → <Acid Goop>.

Name: Gremlin Merc
Notes: [info] Stolen gold is held by Fat Gremlin once summoned.[info] Fight has normal gold reward if Fat Gremlin doesn't escape.

Name: Fat Gremlin
Notes: [info] If Fat Gremlin escapes after stealing gold, you get no gold reward; if he escapes without having stolen gold, you still get 50% of the normal gold reward.

Name: Haunted Ship
Pattern: Opens with <Haunt>; then alternates <Swipe> ↔ <Stomp> (always starting with <Swipe>).

Name: Hunter Killer
Pattern:
Opens with <Tenderizing Goop>.
Then chooses randomly from <Bite>, <Puncture>.

Name: Inklet
Notes: [info] Front and back start with <Jab>. Middle starts with <Whirlwind>.

Name: Leaf Slime (Medium)
Pattern:
Opens with <Sticky Shot>.
Then cycles <Clump Shot> → <Sticky Shot>.

Name: Living Fog
Pattern:
Opens with <Advanced Gas>.
Then cycles <Bloat> → <Super Gas Blast>.

Name: Living Shield
Pattern:
While Turret Operator alive: Always uses <Shield Slam>.
After Turret Operator dies: Always uses <Smash>.

Name: Mawler
Pattern:
Opens with <Claw>.
Then chooses randomly from <Rip & Tear>, <Roar>, <Claw>.

Name: Myte
Notes: [info] 1st starts <Toxic>, 2nd starts <Suck>.

Name: Nibbit
Notes: [info] In 2-Nibbit encounter: front starts <Slice>, back starts <Hiss>.

Name: Ovicopter
Pattern:
Opens with <Lay Eggs> → <Smash> → <Tenderizer>.
If allies ≥ 3 after <Tenderizer>: <Nutritional Paste> → <Smash> → <Tenderizer>.
If allies < 3 after <Tenderizer>: <Lay Eggs> → <Smash> → <Tenderizer>.

Name: Punch Construct
Notes: [info] Punch-Off event: 1st starts <Fast Punch>, 2nd starts <Ready>.

Name: Scroll of Biting
Pattern: Cycles <Chomp> → <More Teeth> → <Chew> (50% chance to repeat <Chew> once).
Notes: [info] 1st/2nd/3rd evenly distributed between <Chomp>, <Chew>, <More Teeth>. 4th starts <More Teeth>.

Name: Sludge Spinner
Pattern:
Opens with <Oil Spray>.
Then chooses randomly from all moves.

Name: Slumbering Beetle
Pattern: Sleeps until awakened, then always uses <Roll Out>.

Name: The Obscura
Pattern:
Opens with <Illusion>.
Then chooses randomly from <Piercing Gaze>, <Wail>, <Hardening Strike>.

Name: Parafright
Notes: [info] Retains Strength after reviving.

Name: Thieving Hopper
Notes: [info] Stolen card is taken from draw or discard pile. Priorities: 1. non-imbued uncommon 2. non-imbued common/rare/event 3. non-imbued basic/quest 4. imbued or ancient 5. curse or anything else.[info] If stunned before turn 5, resumes with next move. If stunned on turn 5, tries <Escape> again.

Name: Toadpole
Notes: [info] Front starts <Spiken>, back starts <Whirl>.

Name: Tunneler
Pattern:
Opens with <Bite> → <Burrow>.
While Burrowed: Always uses <Below>.
After stun: Repeats <Bite> → <Burrow>.

Name: Twig Slime (Medium)
Pattern:
Opens with <Sticky Shot> → <Clump Shot>.
Then chooses randomly from <Sticky Shot>, <Clump Shot>.

Name: Two-Tailed Rat
Pattern:
Chooses randomly from <Scratch>, <Disease Bite>, and <Screech>.
If <Call for Backup> is allowed, 75% chance to use it instead.
Notes: [info]All 3 rats start evenly distributed between <Scratch>, <Disease Bite>, and <Screech>.[info]Only 1 rat can use <Call for Backup> per turn.

Name: Wriggler
Notes: [info] If spawned from Phrog Parasite, starts stunned.[info] Positions 1 & 3 start <Nasty Bite>, positions 2 & 4 start <Wriggle>.

Name: Decimillipede
Pattern:
Cycles <Constrict> → <Bulk> → <Writhe>.
When killed: Revives after 1 turn with 25 HP and continues from next move.
Notes: [info] Fights as 3 segments — HP is always an even number, and segments have different max HP.[info] Segments start evenly distributed between <Writhe>, <Bulk>, and <Constrict>.[bug] Killing a segment with Doom will allow other dead segments to regenerate even if they briefly all appear dead at the same time.

Name: Entomancer
Pattern:
Cycles <Bees> → <Spear> → <Pheromone Spit>.
After 3 stacks of Personal Hive: <Pheromone Spit> gains 2 Strength instead.

Name: Flail Knight
Pattern:
Opens with <Ram>.
Then chooses randomly from <War Chant>, <Flail>, <Ram>.

Name: Spectral Knight
Pattern:
Opens with <Hex> → <Soul Slash>.
Then chooses randomly from <Soul Slash>, <Soul Flame>.

Name: Magi Knight
Pattern:
Opens with <Power Shield> → <Dampen>.
Then cycles <Spear> → <Prep> → <Magic Bomb>.
Notes: [info] Cards can still be upgraded during combat after Magi Knight applies Dampen.

Name: Phantasmal Gardener
Notes: [info] 1st starts <Flail>, 2nd starts <Bite>, 3rd starts <Lash>, 4th starts <Enlarge>.

Name: Soul Nexus
Pattern:
Opens with <Soul Burn>.
Then chooses randomly from <Soul Burn>, <Maelstrom>, <Drain Life>.

Name: Terror Eel
Pattern:
Phase 1:
Cycles <Crash> → <Thrash>.

Phase 2 (stunned at 75 HP):
Uses <Terror>, then cycles <Crash> → <Thrash>.

Name: Ceremonial Beast
Pattern:
Phase 1:
Opens with <Stamp>, then always uses <Plow>.

Phase 2 (after stun):
Cycles <Beast Cry> → <Stomp> → <Crush>.

Name: Aeonglass
Notes: [info] <Increasing Intensity> {strength} gain increases by 1 each use.

Name: Knowledge Demon
Pattern:
Phase 1:
Cycles <Curse of Knowledge> → <Slap> → <Knowledge Overwhelming> → <Ponder> (until <Curse of Knowledge> used 3 times).

Phase 2:
Cycles <Slap> → <Knowledge Overwhelming> → <Ponder>.
Notes: [info] Heal is multiplied by player count in co-op.

Name: Lagavulin Matriarch
Notes: [info] On wakeup all Plating is removed.

Name: Queen
Pattern:
Opens with <Puppet Strings> → <You Are Mine!>.
While Amalgam alive: Always uses <Burn Bright For Me>.
After Amalgam dies: Cycles <Off With Your Head> → <Execution> → <Enrage>.
Notes: [info] If Amalgam dies mid-turn and intent is <Burn Bright For Me>, it becomes <Enrage> instead.
StartsWith: a Torch Head Amalgam in play

Name: Torch Head Amalgam
Pattern:
Opens with <Tackle> → <Tackle>.
Then cycles <Soul Beam> → <Weak Tackle> → <Weak Tackle>.

Name: Soul Fysh
Notes: [info] One of the 2 Intangible from <Fade> ticks down immediately.

Name: Test Subject Stage 1
Pattern:
Cycles <Bite> → <Skull Bash>.
When killed: Revives next turn in Stage 2.

Name: Test Subject Stage 2
Pattern:
Always uses <Multi-Claw>.
When killed: Revives next turn in Stage 3.

Name: The Insatiable
Pattern:
Opens with <Liquify Ground>.
Then cycles <Thrash> → <Lunging Bite> → <Salivate> → <Thrash>.
Notes: [info] If a player is swallowed by the Sandpit effects such as Lizard Tail will not revive you.

Name: Waterfall Giant
Pattern:
Opens with <Pressurize>.
Then cycles <Stomp> → <Ram> → <Siphon> → <Pressure Gun> → <Pressure Up>.
Notes: [info] Heal is multiplied by player count in co-op.
